source_state: Integrated review branch; source identity is bound by SHA-256.
result: Narrowed to odd characteristic, in full generality there: for every finite field F with 2 != 0, every commutative domain R with an involution, and every nontrivial unitary additive character psi : F -> R, the q + 1 bases (standard, and x -> psi(a x^2 + b x) for a in F) are pairwise orthogonal with norms 1 or q and satisfy |<u,v>|^2 q = ||u||^2 ||v||^2 across bases (MubPrimePowerOddCharacteristic.mub_family). The node stays OPEN because characteristic two (d = 2^k, k >= 2) is not constructed and the complex character instance is a parameter.
proof_boundary: The module type-checks with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The character psi is a hypothesis (nontrivial, star psi(t) = psi(-t)); its existence over C (exp(2 pi i Tr(t)/p)) is standard but not constructed in Lean here. Vectors are unnormalised; the unbiasedness relation is stated with the norms, so no square roots appear. Characteristic two beyond dimension 2 is not treated.

limits: Odd characteristic only; the Galois-ring construction for q = 2^k, k >= 2, is not formalised.
psi is a parameter: nontrivial and unitary. The complex instance is not built in Lean (it needs a primitive p-th root of unity in C).
Unbiasedness is stated as |pair u v|^2 * q = pair u u * pair v v with the norms 1 and q; normalised unit vectors are not formed.
Dimension six is not addressed; nothing is inferred about it.
